newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDESpar exchanges CVRD shares.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDESpar exchanges CVRD shares.

text.p: BNDESpar, the investment arm of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), has exchanged shares in federal power holding Eletrobras and state oil giant Petrobras for shares in privatized mining giant CVRD worth 107 million reais, a BNDES spokeswoman said.
BNDESpar exchanged 107.6 million ordinary Eletrobras shares and 134.5 Petrobras preference shares from its portfolio for 4.19 million voting shares in CVRD, the spokeswoman said.
BNDESpar offered to carry out the share exchange in order to discourage minority shareholders in CVRD, especially pension funds, from selling their stakes when the company was privatized in May.
A decision by minority shareholders to sell their stakes at the time of the privatization could have turned the sale unviable. ((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
